observation.command:
cd /workspace/deployment
echo '=== DB check via container ==='
docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T db psql -U qonnectra_user -d qonnectra -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM django_migrations;" 2>&1 | grep -v FIELD_ENCRYPTION
docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T db psql -U qonnectra_user -d qonnectra -tAc "SELECT extname FROM pg_extension ORDER BY 1;" 2>&1 | grep -v FIELD_ENCRYPTION
docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T db psql -U qonnectra_user -d qonnectra -tAc "SELECT username FROM django_session; SELECT 1;" 2>/dev/null | grep -v FIELD_ENCRYPTION | head -3
echo '=== direct port 5440 reachability ==='
timeout 3 bash -c 'echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5440' && echo "port 5440 OPEN" || echo "port 5440 CLOSED"
echo '=== frontend HTML ==='
curl -sk --resolve app.localhost:443:127.0.0.1 https://app.localhost/ | head -c 400; echo
echo '=== backend recent logs ==='
docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml logs --tail 5 backend 2>&1 | grep -v FIELD_ENCRYPTION
